description: This file defines a Spring MVC Controller class 'ProductsController' responsible for handling product management operations in an admin web interface, such as displaying the products page, paginating products, and deleting products. It interacts with services for categories and products, and handles AJAX responses.

classes.name: ProductsController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller handling product administration features such as listing, pagination, and deletion within the admin interface.

methods.name: displayProducts
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the main products management page, loads categories for the store, and sets up the menu.

methods.name: pageProducts
methods.description: Handles POST AJAX requests for fetching paginated product data based on various filters like category, SKU, availability, and search term.

methods.name: deleteProduct
methods.description: Handles POST AJAX requests to delete a product identified by productId, with authorization checks.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up the menu and active menu items in the model for rendering the admin page.
